rationale: No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the child. C03 is the closest because it addresses transportation authority and rail carriers, but it delegates allocation and inventory-control powers under a joint resolution; it does not use the child's Railway Labor Act emergency-board machinery, dispute findings, thirty-day reporting deadline, or temporary prohibition on changes to working conditions. C02 and C04 share only generic executive-order forms and unrelated statutory administration. Any overlap is routine governmental language rather than evidence of reusable drafting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute ... threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce ... to deprive those States of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The authority delegated to the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation ... shall be exercised by him with respect to allocation of transportation facilities and equipment.
shared_material.explanation: Both concern transportation, but the legal predicates, operative mechanisms, and purposes materially differ; this is only broad topical overlap.
